shape.mux_demux_replication: None: each stream uses its own 528 FF and 2 inverter clock path per hop

timing.clocks: ab root west, ba root east; each two-inverter stage forwards a real non-inverted clock. Root waveforms phase independent. No asynchronous groups/false paths/multicycle paths.
timing.hold_requirement: min(source clk-to-Q + routed data + capture input) - (capture propagated clock arrival - launch propagated clock arrival) - capture hold -25ps >=15ps
timing.setup_requirement: 833.333ps + capture propagated clock arrival - launch propagated clock arrival - max(data) - capture setup -60ps >=15ps

geometry.routing: Center spacing does not bound full wire length. Actual endpoint segments, local clock insertion and routed wire length must be reported. Final station-to-pin segment <=100um gate remains open.
geometry.placement: All west s0 cells, including both inverter pairs, fenced west; all east s1 cells fenced east. CTS/hold repair inserted cells require postroute audit.

scope: Minimum full-width two-hop source synchronous route vehicle, not die endpoint or protection qualification. External data budgets are fixture assumptions only; internal paths use actual propagated clocks and parasitics.
